generale.g1: Sposi.live is a complete wedding platform: event website, photo and video collection, interactive games, gift registry, shop and much more.
generale.g2: The Free plan is free forever. Premium and Deluxe are one-time payments that include advanced features such as unlimited videos, original quality and full games.
generale.g3: No. You can create a Free event without a credit card and decide later whether to upgrade.
generale.g4: Yes, the Free plan lets you try all the core features at no cost.
generale.g5: Yes, JustMarry.live is the international version of the platform with English, German, French and Spanish translations.
generale.g6: Of course. JustMarry.live supports international weddings with localized content per country.

piattaforma.p1: Enter the date, the couple names and the ceremony and reception venues. Within minutes the platform generates the event website and activates the available features.
piattaforma.p2: Guests can upload photos and videos, join games, sign the guestbook, vote and contribute to the shared playlist.
piattaforma.p3: Yes, every event has a QR code that guests scan with their phone to access the event features directly.
piattaforma.p4: The upload window opens 18 days before the event and closes 2 days after, so everyone has time to upload without stress.
piattaforma.p5: Yes, you can create and manage multiple events from the same account, each with its own settings and guests.
piattaforma.p6: You can update the date and location at any time from the event settings.

foto.f1: Photos are stored on Cloudflare R2 for instant viewing and permanently on the couple Google Drive as backup.
foto.f2: Yes, photos over 2 MB are compressed for fast uploads. Originals remain available to the couple on paid plans.
foto.f3: Yes, the couple can download high-quality photos from both the gallery and the Google Drive backup.
foto.f4: Yes, if you connect Google Drive, all photos and videos are automatically synced into organized folders.
foto.f5: A watermark with the couple names and logo is applied automatically on gallery photos, while the original stays clean on Drive.
foto.f6: Only the couple, delegates and the uploader of the photo can delete it from the gallery.

giochi.j1: The Feed, Rate the Fit, Photo Hunt, Couple Quiz, Selfie Booth, First Drink, Wow Walk and Video Challenges are included. Advanced games require Premium or Deluxe.
giochi.j2: The Video Guestbook lets guests record a video message that the couple can keep forever.
giochi.j3: The Time Capsule lets you seal messages and photos to be reopened on a future date, such as your 10th anniversary.
giochi.j4: Guests register, receive photo challenges and earn points by uploading the requested photos. Highest score wins.
giochi.j5: The Feed is a live stream of the event photos and videos, shown in real time during the party.
giochi.j6: Yes, you can enable or disable each game from the settings based on your plan and preferences.

commerce.c1: The Shop lets the couple create a catalog of wedding-related products that guests can purchase.
commerce.c2: The Gift Registry lets guests contribute with cash or a chosen item from the list, with secure payment.
commerce.c3: Yes, all payments are processed through Stripe with encryption and PCI compliance.
commerce.c4: Payments are handled by Stripe, the world leader in online payments. We never handle card data directly.
commerce.c5: Yes, through Gelato you can sell custom print-on-demand products without managing inventory.
commerce.c6: Payment processing fees are Stripe standard fees. Platform fees vary by plan.

privacy.pr1: We process guest data only for the wedding operations: photos, game participation and event-related communications.
privacy.pr2: Yes, we are GDPR compliant. You can export or delete all data at any time.
privacy.pr3: Yes, you can delete the event and all associated data from the settings.
privacy.pr4: No, photos are only visible to the event guests through the QR code or invitation.
privacy.pr5: No, facial recognition is an optional feature that requires explicit consent from each guest.
privacy.pr6: You can contact us at the email address in the footer to request access, rectification or deletion of your data.

tecnico.t1: We support recent versions of Chrome, Safari, Firefox and Edge on desktop and mobile.
tecnico.t2: Yes, the whole platform is responsive and works perfectly on mobile, also as an installable PWA.
tecnico.t3: The PWA supports offline mode for core features, while uploads are queued and completed when you are back online.
tecnico.t4: Contact us via support. Most issues are solved by refreshing the browser and retrying.
tecnico.t5: Uploads pause and resume automatically as soon as the connection is back, thanks to the offline queue.
tecnico.t6: Email us at the support address in the footer, we reply within 24 working hours.
tecnico.t7: We use Stripe for payments, Resend for emails and Spotify for the shared playlist.
